name: Chengdu M&S Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengdu M&S Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. is a company dedicated to the research, development, production, and sale of satellite communication technologies and systems. Operating in both the domestic Chinese and international markets, the firm's offerings include satellite navigation devices, specialized test equipment for navigation systems, and various technical support services. They also provide dynamic mobile satellite communication solutions designed for use in maritime vessels, aircraft, and automobiles. A primary application for their satellite communication products lies within the civil aviation sector. The company was established in 2013 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
